text: Adding water to cool the stirred curd stops the pieces from matting together into slabs, the step that defines cheddaring. This gives a cheese with up to 40% moisture.

steps.note: Water is added to the curd, so its pieces do not mat together.
The cheese is ripened this long only if it is made from raw milk.
